# Candidate Assessment: Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | None listed | ❌ |
| 9 | Kafka | None listed | ❌ |
| 10 | GraphQL | None listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 7 of 10 = 70%**

The posting lists Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, and Helm as one numbered item. If you count them as five separate requirements, the score falls to 7 of 14 = 50%. The candidate has none of the five tools, so either way the result is below the cutoff.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below the 78% Cutoff

The candidate's mandatory match of **70%** is below your **78% cutoff**. The gaps are all in the infrastructure and data layer:
- **Containers, orchestration, and infrastructure as code** (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm)
- **Event streaming** (Kafka)
- **GraphQL**

As you instructed, I did not evaluate the nice-to-have requirements.
